title: Conduct or facilitate security audits: decision comparison 1
teachingQuestion: What makes an audit conclusion credible and what closes a finding?
focalInsight: Audit conclusion is bounded by criteria, scope, period, independence, and sampled evidence.
caption: Compare meaning, decision conditions, and failures. These concise distinctions are paired with the worked examples in the teaching unit.
altSummary: Audit conclusion is bounded by criteria, scope, period, independence, and sampled evidence.
textFallback:
audit: criteria-based examination. Decision: define period/scope. Failure/example: certificate overreach
audit independence: unbiased evaluator. Decision: manage conflict. Failure/example: operator audit
audit criteria: expected standard. Decision: map control. Failure/example: undefined benchmark
audit evidence: supporting artifact. Decision: test reliability. Failure/example: policy-only
sampling: evidence subset. Decision: justify selection. Failure/example: cherry-pick
follow up: corrective closure. Decision: retest evidence. Failure/example: finding disappears
